purpose: Strictly name-matched, openly licensed Shariatpur landmark facade photo references. Only apply a photo when a source building name matches an alias exactly; never use as generic texture.
limitations: These are landmark reference photographs, not a complete set for every Shariatpur building.
OSM name matching is not proof of surveyed coordinates; inspect the resulting GLB before release.
CC BY-SA 4.0 texture derivatives must remain available under compatible share-alike terms; keep each photo and attribution separate from unrelated game assets.
No Google Maps imagery is downloaded or redistributed.
